UserData.title: UserData
UserData.description: User account data containing synchronized profile, study settings, task manifests, schedule state, and game high scores across devices.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: The user's Google account email address.

photoURL.description: The user's Google avatar photo URL.

profile.description: The chosen character profile, avatar ID, title, and quote.

tasks.description: List of study subject tasks in the manifest.

highScores.description: User high scores for break games.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user data including study tasks, schedule, and chosen hero profile, accessible only by the authenticated owner.
